title: Coupled Field Vortex Model: Reproducible V0.1 Research Release
description: Reproducible research release for a coupled Abelian-Higgs and neutral-scalar vortex model. The V0.1 scope centers on perturbative displacement of the critical Bogomolny boundary, planar-interface calculations, numerical validation, and documented reproducibility. The model class is treated as established physics; candidate contributions are stated conservatively and separated from known results.
